scope: Two complete candidate HOB cards using accepted recruit, Saga, return, counters, exact cast-origin and amass mechanics; no engine changes

cards.name: Tidings of War
obligations: Amass Goblins 3 from graveyard independent of casting permission
Uncast copies amass 1 despite inherited origin
Creates black Goblin Army only without a controlled Army, otherwise grows own Army

cards.name: The Mountain-king's Return
obligations: Costs 2W; enters with first lore and recruits
Recruit draws before mandatory private discard; nonland creates 1/1 white Human Soldier, land creates none
Second chapter returns own creature card with mana value at most 3 untapped
Second chapter rejects opponent graveyard, noncreature and over-cost cards
Third chapter optionally targets any creature, including opponents, and adds one +1/+1 counter
Exact chapter target references never rebind after same-slot reentry
Final Saga is sacrificed after third chapter resolves, fizzles, or chooses no targets

first_run.result: 3 passed; one setup failure used absent Centaur Courser; replaced fixture with supported MV=3 Thrashing Brontodon
